mission.title: Pack Grab
mission.description: Retrieve one of the imposter Agents' Devices for Zion.

phase.briefing:
The imposter Agents are now the main threat to Zion. Aside from the fact that we know they are trying to disrupt our Truce with the Machines, their origins and intentions remain a mystery to us. Commander Lock thinks that their light-emitting Devices may hold a clue to where these pests are coming from and, more importantly, how we can rid the Matrix of them.
We've just learned that a small team of these imposter Agents is in your vicinity. You should be able to handle these few imposters easily, Warrior. Retrieve one of their Devices and upload it to Zion.

enter.say: The small imposter team is in that building. They don't appear to be moving--it should be easy for you to intercept them.

done.say: Uh-oh... {player}, I'm picking up a significant number of additional imposter Agents approaching. Watch your back!

objective.text: Get the Device from the imposter Agent

done.say: That's one of the Devices we need! Quickly, find a hardline outside and upload the Device to us.

objective.text: Kill all of the imposter Agents

done.say: It appears that the first two called in reinforcements when they detected your approach.

objective.text: Upload the Device at a hardline

done.say: We're receiving the Device data now...
You've done well, Warrior! Once our engineers have analyzed the Device, we may be able to crack the mystery of these troublesome fake Agents.

mission.finish: Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment.
